scope.summary: api-lock CI job made green on a fresh runner: 9a3d6e2e fetches each baseline's locked dependencies online before the offline baseline rustdoc build; 8cdcd754 forces CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never so the semver-checks report parses; d5cfd08e/34289cb7 refresh the committed public-API snapshots with the reviewed 0.12 additions listed in CHANGELOG [Unreleased].

entry_points.name: api-lock CI job on a fresh runner (orchestrator-read verdict)

entry_points.name: prepush head check
entry_points.trace: Orchestrator prepush.sh now runs bash scripts/oraclemcp_api_lock.sh on every agent push (added 2026-09-25 after the drift escaped), so unreviewed public-API drift is caught before landing.

limitations: The same CI run is red on the separate 'Oracle FREE 23ai matrix' job, caused by .10.19 (tracked there), not by this bead.
For a major release semver-checks evaluates zero checks by design; drift detection comes from the committed cargo public-api snapshots.
